 3.

solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - a, 2 - b, 3 - c.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct answer **matches **Kerala with Anaimalai Hills**, **Meghalaya** with **Garo Hills, **and** Mizoram** with **Lushai Hills.**
 
• **Anaimalai Hills** are a range of hills in the **Western Ghats of Kerala** and **Tamil Nadu,** known for their **biodiversity and scenic beauty.**
 
• **Garo Hills** are a part of the **Garo-Khasi range** in **Meghalaya**, home to the **Garo people** and known for their **forests, waterfalls, and wildlife.**
 
• **Lushai Hills** are a range of hills in** Mizoram, **named after the **Lushai people** who inhabit the area, and known for their **rugged terrain **and **rich flora and fauna.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kerala, Meghalaya, and Mizoram are all states in India, located in different regions of the country and known for their distinct cultures, languages, and natural features.
